description: Get one session in full by sessionId. Use it when you need a single session's description or speaker roster; use list_sessions to find the id. Returns title, status, type, format, time, room, track, description, speakers[] with role and confirmation, and a deep link url.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

sessionId.description: Session id, as returned by list_sessions.

name: get_session

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end time, or null when unscheduled.

speakerNames.description: Names of the people on the session.

role.description: Role on the session, e.g. speaker or moderator.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 start time, or null when unscheduled.

status.description: Session status, e.g. proposed, accepted, confirmed, rejected.

type.description: Session type, e.g. talk, keynote, panel, workshop.

url.description: Deep link to the session, or null.
